name: Iori
message: 「All right, that's it for Asahi's training. Setsugekka, you're up next.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh yeah, I'm going in！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Good luck, Seccha~n.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You can cheer for me too, you know, Momimomi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Do your best to drag the match out as long as possible, and draw out even a shred of useful information for me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Putting yourself first, huh！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sheesh, Momimomi, you're no fun as a friend.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, since when were you and I friends？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sniff, sniff... That's so mean, Ririmu-chan, Momimomi is being so cold to meee.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The~re, there, I'm your friend, okay~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Quit the boring act and get out there already.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okaa~y.」
After doing a quick stretch, Setsugekka stepped up in front of me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well then, Muragaki-sensei, please teach me well！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, let's get started.」
We both drew our Origami and took our stances.

name: Iori
message: 「This is the second time we've gone at it, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, I was out of control last time, so I don't really remember much...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Was I strong？」

name: Iori
message: 「I could sense your potential.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Isn't that just a roundabout way of saying, 'You're weak right now'？」

name: Iori
message: 「If you're not happy with that, prove your strength right here.」
I flashed her a grin.

name: Iori
message: 「Right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Indeed.」
Just as I saw Setsugekka lightly lean her body forward—
She charged in with the speed of a bullet！
Her posture was extremely low, making her quite a nuisance for anyone trying to intercept her with a blade.

name: Iori
message: 「Nice Shukuchi！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's nothing special！」
She utilized the twist from unleashing her reverse-grip blade to launch a roundhouse kick.
This combination of Origami and hand-to-hand combat was truly masterful.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eat this! Mishima-ryuu Type Hinoe: Ugachibi!」
Her palm, fingers curled like a tiger's claw, thrust upward from below.
Her target—was my crotch.

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, I'd really rather you didn't hit that！」
I countered her outstretched hand by slamming a knee reinforced with a thick layer of Barrier Jacket into her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ow-ow-owww！？」
Setsugekka retreated, rubbing her fist after being countered by my knee.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way, you actually pinpointed my attack and intercepted it with your knee...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, don't tell me you're also trained in hand-to-hand combat, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, striking, grappling, throwing—I've mastered them all to some extent.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh~！？ I thought I was the only one who fought like this.」

name: Iori
message: 「It's actually quite common in the Tenju Special Forces where I'm stationed. Learning combat arts is built into our training.」
However, it is quite rare for an academy student to fight primarily using martial arts.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh... I had no idea.」

name: Iori
message: 「By the way, there's a Mishima-ryuu user in the Tenju Special Forces too.」

name: Iori
message: 「We spar occasionally, so I have a pretty good read on your movements.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-wait, does that mean my fighting style is completely exposed to you！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's cheating, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'd like you to look at it more positively.」

name: Iori
message: 「Since I know the ins and outs of the Mishima-ryuu, that means I know exactly where you can improve.」

name: Iori
message: 「In other words, you can get even stronger than you are now！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh~ I see. You might be right!」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on, Setsugekka, don't hold back—show me your skill.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Understood！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hyaaah—Type Tsuchinoto: Chibashiri！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Your wind-up is way too big！ Your opponent will see your attack coming！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-Yeees！」
For a while now, Iori-sensei has been repeatedly letting Setsugekka attack him, dutifully receiving her strikes or countering them.

name: Momiji
message: （If it were me, I'd never let her get close though~）
It goes without saying, but with hand-to-hand combat, you can't attack your opponent unless you get within arm's or leg's reach.
Inevitably, it becomes an infighting style.
With a katana, though, you have longer reach. If you keep them from getting close, you can take them down without even giving them a chance to attack.

name: Momiji
message: （Well, it's instructional sparring, so I guess he's just letting her strike him.）
In short, Sensei is holding back quite a bit while sparring with Setsugekka.
It's the same when he spars with Ririmu or Asahi, too.

name: Momiji
message: （He doesn't show his true strength at all, that teacher~）
I want to see a little more of what he's got up his sleeve.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, Asahi, got a second？」

name: Asahi
message: 「What is it?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I wanted to ask you about Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, certainly.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If it's about Iori-sensei, I know everything—from his measurements and morning routine to his everyday hobbies and what type of woman he likes.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'd be delighted to tell you. What would you like to know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「N-No, that's not what I meant.」
Oh, though I might be a little curious about his type in women.

name: Momiji
message: 「Just wondering how Iori-sensei actually fights.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Actually fights？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, he hasn't been getting serious this whole time, has he?」

name: Momiji
message: 「It just looks like he's holding back.」
Iori-sensei is certainly strong as he is right now. Even so, I couldn't possibly believe that was his limit.

name: Asahi
message: 「...As expected of the Suzakuin, you have a keen eye.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Indeed, Iori-sensei has yet to reveal his true essence.」

name: Momiji
message: 「His true essence？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm sure you've heard of it at least once before, Momiji-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「The rumors surrounding the Muragaki family, the Shogunate's Oniwabanshu.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei is the eldest son of that Muragaki family, and their current head.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah... I see.」
The Muragaki family―they were a clan of pure―blooded assassins, integrated into the Oniwabanshu to eliminate those who were inconvenient to the Shogunate.
Their specialties were swordsmen—specifically, the Ikusabito who could freely wield spirit blades.
Even if the opponent was a swordsman capable of manipulating powerful Tenju that commanded the weather, a single Muragaki assassin would take them down.
It is said that they would bury such spirit-blade-wielding swordsmen who did not show loyalty to the Shogunate, recovering their blades only to destroy them.

name: Momiji
message: （Truly the Shogunate's hidden blade. They say the samurai of that era used to whisper that 'not even an Ikusabito could best a Muragaki', or something like that.）
When the Shogunate fell during the Meiji Restoration, the Oniwabanshu were relieved of their duties, and the Muragaki family, having lost their patronage, fell into decline.
Thereafter, the Muragaki family continued their lineage quietly in the shadows of history until Suzakuin Ryouan requested they join the newly formed Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association.

Within the association, there were families who harbored deep-seated grudges because their daimyo or retainers had been cut down by the Muragaki during the Tokugawa Shogunate, and some opposed their entry, but Ryouan persuaded them.
The Muragaki family agreed, and it is said they were then incorporated into the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association.

name: Momiji
message: （Well, yeah, because it'd be a nightmare if the Muragaki turned into your enemy...）
The Self-Defense Association was formed shortly after the war, in an era where the GHQ was still operating behind the scenes.
The Muragaki—killers of master swordsmen—were the natural enemy of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association; had they fallen to the GHQ, catastrophe would have been unavoidable.

name: Momiji
message: （The Suzakuin must have had one or two grudges against the Muragaki family themselves, so I suppose my ancestor Ryouan must have had a tough decision to make~）

The Suzakuin Family, who possessed hidden spirit blades, had been targeted by the Muragaki many times, sometimes killed, and had the spirit blades passed down through their generations stolen by them.

name: Momiji
message: （Well, not that it matters to me, though.）
The past is the past. I have zero intention of going out of my way to inherit something as fucking troublesome as a grudge.
—With that thought crossing my mind in about 0.1 seconds, I ask Asahi.

name: Momiji
message: 「So, what's the true essence of the Muragaki Family？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Tengen Saimei―ryuu―a killing sword style devised to slay master swordsmen.」
Asahi's face was stiff and tense as she told me that.

name: Momiji
message: 「I see. So that's why you were so cautious during the match earlier, Asahi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You've seen Iori-sensei's Tengen Saimei-ryuu before, haven't you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「...I really can't lie to you, can I?」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's true that I was afraid of Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No swordsman who has faced it could ever forget it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Whoa, it's really that amazing?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'd love to see it too~ Tengen Saimei-ryuu.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Momiji-san, please understand this much at least.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei hates Saimei-ryuu.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei is a very kind-hearted person. You can figure out the rest, can't you?」
Ah, so that's how it is...

name: Asahi
message: 「Therefore, I don't believe one should seek out Saimei-ryuu lightly.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Though... even if I tried to stop you, you'd surely still seek it out, wouldn't you?」
...Man, this girl is surprisingly sharp.

name: Momiji
message: 「Seeking out strong opponents to grow stronger. That's only natural for a swordsman, isn't it?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I understand. I'm something of a swordsman myself, after all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That aside, I must admit I'd like to see it too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「What kind of reaction you'll show when facing Saimei-ryuu.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sure, I'll show you.」
The Muragaki Family's Tengen Saimei-ryuu—I'll drag it out of him, even if I have to do it by force.
As we were talking like that—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nnhyaaaaaaaahhh~~！！」
Thrown back by the momentum of her own charge, Setsugekka took the full force of Iori-sensei’s attack and went rolling into the training ground wall.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah, hah…… haaah…… fuuuu……！！」
When Setsugekka stood back up, her eyes were burning with flames of rage.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Damn you, damn you…… that hurts, you piece of shit！」

name: Momiji
message: （Ah—oh no, is she starting up again……）

name: Iori
message: 「My bad, I put a bit too much into that one. Are you alright, Setsugekka?」
I called out to Setsugekka as she rose to her feet.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ha, obviously.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A strike like this is nothing more than a mere scratch to me！」
This is…… it’s just like that time before.
Her eyes have the same look as they did when she destroyed the arena wall.
Setsugekka is in a berserk state right now.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, calm down and listen to me. You’re currently in a berserk state.」

name: Iori
message: 「Quiet your heart and regain control！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How noisy you are, man…… all that matters now is that we cut each other down！」
She approached me with unbelievable speed, delivering a blow with a weight incomparable to anything before.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kukuku…… what’s wrong? Is barking all you’re good for?」
She pressed her blade hard against mine, forcing a stalemate. Her strength was slightly superior to mine.

name: Iori
message: 「Who are you……！？」
Her speech, her aura, and even her Tenju power are completely different from the usual Setsugekka. It’s as if a different personality has taken residence within her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph…… man, it seems you’ve misunderstood something.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I am Kazamine Setsugekka, and no one else！」

name: Iori
message: 「It doesn’t look that way to me……！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In normal times, my hidden nature is simply veiled.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Do not speak such nonsense about which is the ‘true’ self—the mask or the nature.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Front and back, Yin and Yang, united as one. That is the truth of the world！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In other words, both are Kazamine Setsugekka, and both are me！！」
I somehow managed to block her thunderous thrust with my elbow.
Thrown back about a meter by the impact—Setsugekka pursues me relentlessly.

name: Iori
message: （You’ve really got quite the constitution, don’t you...！）
I strike back against Setsugekka’s slash with one hundred percent of my power.
Yet, it’s just a draw.
Even though this is enough force to effortlessly slam Ririmu or Asahi into a wall, Setsugekka takes it head-on without flinching.

name: Iori
message: （If she could control this, she’d even surpass Victoria...！！）
Keisetsu said the key was whether Setsugekka could control this runaway state. I’m feeling that reality sinking in now.
If she could freely manipulate this overwhelming spiritual power, Setsugekka would be the strongest in this academy.
If she polished her skills, she might even be able to close the gap on our company commander, who can hold off entire battalions.

name: Iori
message: 「...Keisetsu！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What？」
Keisetsu replies from a distance.

name: Iori
message: 「I want to stop Setsugekka’s rampage. What should I do！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It will stop if she lets go of her Origami.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see... if that’s the only way, then so be it.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m going to be a bit rough, you don’t mind, right？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, just try not to hurt her too much.」

name: Iori
message: 「Understood！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, ‘a bit rough,’ you say？ You’re all talk.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Do you really think someone like you can surpass me?!」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, as arrogant as it sounds, I do.」
I ready my Origami and face the rampaging Setsugekka once more.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, your talent is truly exceptional.」

name: Iori
message: 「But as you are now, there’s no way you can become a Toujinegi！」
This time, I unleash my Origami first.
Setsugekka takes my slash, which cuts at an acute angle, in her side.

name: Iori
message: 「You want to know the reason? I’ll tell you.」

name: Iori
message: 「In this state, you’ve lost your cool and can only see what’s right in front of you！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gh... ahhh！？」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why I’m saying, you can’t even dodge an attack like this！！」

name: Iori
message: 「You should have been able to parry that with Mishima-ryuu Type Mizunoe: Wakinagashi！」

name: Iori
message: 「You can block this with Type Kanoto: Ginjun！」

name: Iori
message: 「For that last slash, you could have counterattacked at the lower leg with Type Kou: Edanagi！」
Every strike I unleash lands on Setsugekka, whittling down her Barrier Jacket.

name: Iori
message: 「If you weren’t out of control, you should have been able to deal with this level of intensity calmly.」

name: Iori
message: 「As you are now, you’re no different from a child, relying on brute force and just thrashing about.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You bastard... calling me a mere child, of all things...！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I will never forgive you...！！！」
Setsugekka readies her fist and begins to concentrate her fighting spirit.

name: Iori
message: 「One of the secret techniques of the Mishima-ryuu, Type Mizunoto: Banzetsu, is it?」
That’s the very same blow that destroyed the wall of the arena before.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, that technique leaves you wide open.」

name: Iori
message: 「Not everyone is going to just watch and wait for you to finish your preparation.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, have you turned coward, you wretch！！」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m not a wretch, I’m your teacher！！」
I step in hard, closing the distance to Setsugekka.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hahaha, a fly buzzing straight into the flames！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eat this, Mishima―ryuu Type Mizunoto: Banze―」
Just before Setsugekka can throw her fist—my palm heel drives deep into her solar plexus.

name: Iori
message: 「Training is over, Setsugekka.」
I take the Origami from her slightly loosened grip.
Having lost the power of her Tenju, Setsugekka collapses, strengthless.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, you need to assess the situation more calmly.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you can’t do that, you’ll never become a first-rate swordsman.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Nn, ugh？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? Why am I... lying on the ground?」

name: Iori
message: 「Back to normal, are you？」
I help Setsugekka up and sheath the Origami I had taken from her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah~... wait, did I go berserk again？」

name: Iori
message: 「So this Setsugekka doesn’t remember, huh.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s not that I don’t remember, exactly~, hahaha...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s more like... the feeling of having been having a dream, or something.」

name: Iori
message: 「How do you feel？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uh, well, my stomach kind of hurts.」
Setsugekka rubs the area where I struck her with my palm.

name: Iori
message: 「My bad. Let’s head to the medical room later.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-no... it’s fine, I’m totally fine!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aah, it’s already healed! Man, I’m hungry~!」
Nope, it seems she doesn't want to go together.

name: Iori
message: 「Don't push yourself, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okay... I’m sorry for going berserk.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't worry about it. As long as you’re safe, that’s all that matters.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But I do remember being scolded a whole lot while I was out of control...」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, you remember that part.」
Front and back, Yin and Yang—together they are one. Perhaps what the berserk Setsugekka said is surprisingly true.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It really is no good, isn't it? To not be able to control myself...」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s certainly not good to go berserk.」

name: Iori
message: 「You might cause trouble for others, and it has to be a heavy burden on your body, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, I’m sorry...」

name: Iori
message: 「But your Mental Resonance Coefficient when you were out of control was extraordinary.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you can control that, becoming Toujinegi is no mere dream！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「R-Really？」

name: Iori
message: 「You're a rare diamond in the rough with the hidden potential to be the strongest in the academy.」

name: Iori
message: 「From here on out, let's figure out a way to control that power.」

name: Iori
message: 「As long as you don't give up, I'll never give up either. I promise.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's work hard together from now on, alright！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「S-Sensei...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sniff, sniff... You're such a good person, Muragaki-sensei...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Permission to fall in love with you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Starting today, I'm officially Asahi-chan's rival！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whaaaaaaat！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Sigh, so it really has come to this.」
Asahi walked over with a look of complete enlightenment.

name: Iori
message: 「W-Wait, what's going on here！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei is the most charming man in this entire world.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nah, that's definitely going too far.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Therefore, some girls are bound to fall for him once they see his virtues. At this point, it's a self-evident truth.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, I was like half-joking, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, I think I get a little bit of how Asahi-chan feels about wanting Muragaki-sensei all to herself！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Having him all to yourself is impossible, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei has explicitly stated that he treats everyone equally and plays no favorites.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If he were ever going to belong to just one person, I would have already made him mine long ago.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh, is that so？」

name: Iori
message: 「Just as Asahi says, I have no intention of playing favorites with anyone.」

name: Iori
message: 「I intend to provide instruction without bias, so that everyone can draw out their abilities to their own personal limits.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch, that’s a shame.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Anyway, Iori-sensei, please don’t go around offering kind words indiscriminately.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I would be troubled if you increased my rivals any further.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, right.」
I didn’t really have any such intentions, though…

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh, I’ve got a good idea.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, hey, Teach, let’s go out together！」
Ririmu wraps her arms tightly around mine.

name: Iori
message: 「W-wait a minute, you too, Ririmu！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, there’s no need to pay any mind to that.」
As if in opposition, Asahi wraps her arms around my other side.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san’s behavior is meant just to spite me, and there are absolutely no special feelings involved.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You can just think of that arm as having a filthy rag wrapped around it, and feel free to leave it be.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, wait, who are you calling a filthy rag, you brat！！」
The usual squabble between Asahi and Ririmu began.

name: Ririmu
message: 「And besides, don’t you go deciding on your own that I don’t have special feelings.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I, I’m actually a little bit interested in you too, Teach！」

name: Iori
message: 「Eh, is that so？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well… just a little, just a tiny bit！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Apparently, it’s about the same as a speck of dust.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don’t go adding unnecessary supplements！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, yeah yeah, sorry to interrupt your little lovey-dovey time, but~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’d like you to attend to me now, Iori-sensei？」
Momiji approaches with a sharp look in her eyes.
